items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: they had the Berry Brothers in the show, which

ctx.x: See, she was already in London. She was living in London and she joined the show after we got there. And of course they had the Berry Brothers in the show, which

was a great dance act at that time, and different people. I can't remember who, who they were. But they had a chorus, chorus girls. They had about 12 chorus girls. It was a big show, a big production. We played the Palladium in London about -- oh, I don't know how long we played. I can't remember. Maybe we played it a month, I believe. Yeah. Then we went to Paris and we played the Moulin Rouge in Paris, and the Moulin Rouge was one of the greatest nightclubs I'd ever seen. They must have had half a dozen bands…
